scope.summary: #51: a second oraclemcp instance completes the MCP handshake over stdio and HTTP behind a held audit/service-owner lock; every tools/call returns typed ORACLEMCP_AUDIT_LOG_LOCKED (HTTP 429 + Retry-After) naming the holder pid (Unix); no DB connection while locked; recovers without restart after the holder exits; doctor reports audit_log_locked (0610eddb, 47ee1015, 67e42870, dd28855a, fc6dd3ee, 32504f70).
out_of_scope: crates/oraclemcp-audit/src/sink.rs was changed afterwards by .12.1 (a21b555b) and is excluded from the clean-scope claim.
Windows lock semantics and shared-chain concurrency (bead no-claim); the Windows holder-pid assertion is Unix-only by design (32504f70).
